notes: Single-stage: author a pinned rule set and a scanner that applies re.search rules over log files, extracts IPv4s from matching lines, and emits alert.json (timestamp + alerts with id/severity/matches/ips) and report.json (events + statistics map of per-rule counts). Hidden cases probe missing/invalid rules files, invalid regexes, default threshold/severity, missing-empty logs, zero-match firing (threshold 0), and default-rules invocation. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth, adversarial_inputs, hidden_case_generalization, quantitative_correctness.
